article_title: 'Fascinating' rare beetle found in Wales again after three year search

tasks.prompt: What is the main focus of the article?
options: Conservationists found evidence that a nationally rare beetle is breeding in Wales again after decades of absence.
Scientists introduced a foreign beetle species to every part of Wales.
A coastal development project forced all wildlife away from Pembrokeshire.
Researchers proved that solitary bees can live without flowers.
tasks.correct_answer: Conservationists found evidence that a nationally rare beetle is breeding in Wales again after decades of absence.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת בגילוי זחלים של חיפושית נדירה בפמברוקשייר, גילוי המעיד שהמין שוב מתרבה בוויילס לאחר עשרות שנים.

tasks.prompt: Why were experts especially encouraged by this year's survey at Castlemartin?
options: They found the largest adult beetle ever recorded.
They discovered larvae after last year's survey had found only dead adults.
They counted thousands of solitary bee nests across Wales.
They moved the beetles from Devon to Pembrokeshire.
tasks.correct_answer: They discovered larvae after last year's survey had found only dead adults.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בשנה שעברה נמצאו רק בוגרים מתים, ואילו השנה נמצאו זחלים — ראיה חיובית לכך שמתקיימת רבייה במקום.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “on the brink of extinction” mean?
options: Beginning to spread rapidly
Protected from every possible danger
Close to disappearing completely
Living only during warm afternoons
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי on the brink of extinction פירושו שהמין היה קרוב מאוד להיעלמות מוחלטת.

tasks.prompt: Which habitat does the Short-Necked Oil Beetle need?
options: Cold mountain woodland with little vegetation
Deep freshwater lakes with rocky shores
Urban parks with closely cut grass
Flower-rich coastal grassland or sand dunes with sheltering vegetation
tasks.correct_answer: Flower-rich coastal grassland or sand dunes with sheltering vegetation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציינת שהחיפושית זקוקה לשטחי עשב חופיים או דיונות עשירי פרחים, עם צמחייה עבה למחסה.

tasks.prompt: What other animal is essential to the beetle's lifecycle?
options: Solitary bees
Coastal birds
Sand lizards
Freshwater insects
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החיפושית תלויה בדבורים יחידאיות לצורך מחזור החיים שלה.

tasks.prompt: What does “vulnerable” indicate in the beetle's IUCN Red List classification?
options: The species is common and increasing everywhere.
The species has already disappeared from Britain.
The species faces a significant risk and needs conservation attention.
The species is dangerous to people who touch it.
tasks.correct_answer: The species faces a significant risk and needs conservation attention.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בדירוג שימור, vulnerable מציין שמין נמצא בסיכון משמעותי ולכן דורש תשומת לב והגנה.

tasks.prompt: Give two pieces of evidence that suggest the beetle is breeding at Castlemartin.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שתי ראיות מדויקות מהסקר הנוכחי ומהשוואתו לשנה הקודמת.
expected_points: Surveyors found beetle larvae after three years of searching.
The number and distribution of the larvae suggested they came from a larger batch of immature beetles.
Last year's survey found only dead adults, whereas larvae provide evidence of a new generation.

tasks.prompt: Why are there only a handful of suitable sites for this beetle in the UK?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין צורכי בית הגידול, התלות בדבורים יחידאיות ואובדן בתי גידול.
expected_points: The beetle needs a very specific combination of flower-rich coastal grassland or dunes and thick vegetation.
It depends on solitary bees during its lifecycle.
Habitat loss previously brought the species close to extinction.
Suitable warm, sunny coastal conditions are therefore uncommon.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the discovery, the beetle's needs and the conservation response in 3–4 sentences.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול את הגילוי, משמעות הזחלים, בית הגידול והתוכנית לשימור.
expected_points: Larvae of the Short-Necked Oil Beetle were found at Castlemartin after years of searching.
The find suggests the nationally rare species is breeding in Wales again after a long absence.
The beetle depends on solitary bees and flower-rich coastal habitat with dense vegetation.
Conservationists will continue surveying and managing the site as part of a species recovery programme.

tasks.prompt: Write a short visitor notice explaining how people can help protect the beetle's habitat at Castlemartin.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח הודעה ברורה ומכבדת המבוססת על צורכי המין, ללא המצאת כללים רשמיים שאינם בכתבה.
expected_points: Explain that Castlemartin is the only known Welsh site for the rare beetle.
Mention the importance of flower-rich vegetation and solitary bees.
Ask visitors generally to avoid damaging habitat and to respect conservation work, while not inventing specific legal restrictions.
